# Action Groups Extended

Integrates extended action groups into Gonogo's action group system.

An Uplink for [Gonogo](https://ksp-gonogo.github.io/), the mission-control dashboard for Kerbal Space Program that runs in a web browser on any screen.

Built against Action Groups Extended 2.4.1.4.

## Install

Install the Action Groups Extended Uplink with CKAN: search for `GonogoActionGroupsExtendedUplink`, tick it and apply. CKAN also installs Gonogo itself and Action Groups Extended.

Without CKAN, download `GonogoActionGroupsExtendedUplink.zip` from the releases page, unpack it into your Kerbal Space Program folder so that it lands in `GameData/GonogoActionGroupsExtendedUplink`, and install Gonogo the same way.

Releases: https://github.com/ksp-gonogo/gonogo-uplinks/releases?q=actionGroupsExtended-v
